issuer: the Dirección de Tránsito y Transporte Público of the municipality where the applicant lives

licence.name: licencia de conducir no profesional clase B

note: Read 2026-10-30 on ChileAtiende, the government's services portal (the page's information is the Subsecretaría de Transportes'). The class B licence (cars for up to 9 passengers) is had from 18, exceptionally from 17 with a driving-school course, a parent's authorisation and a licensed adult beside the driver (not held), and is applied for at the municipality's traffic office, the municipality where the applicant lives; the page says its cost depends on each municipality, so the fee is null. Its term (the Traffic Law's control period) wasn't read: the page doesn't give it and the Library of Congress's LeyChile answered 401 to every request today, so validYears is null. ChileAtiende has pages for exchanging the licences of Ecuador, Argentina (the national licence only), Paraguay, South Korea, Spain and Peru, with a certificate from the Subsecretaría de Transportes, but none of them says whether the municipality's tests are waived, so no exchange is held. The identity card is the ids engine's.

sources.said: Es un documento físico o digital que te permite, a partir de los 18 años, conducir vehículos motorizados de 3 o más ruedas ... Tener un mínimo de 18 años de edad. ... Dirección de Tránsito y Transporte Público de la municipalidad ... correspondiente a tu residencia ... El costo de la licencia depende de cada municipalidad.
